destructive criticism: Instead of helping her improve, the coach's destructive criticism made the young swimmer lose all her confidence.
教練破壞性的批評沒有幫助她進步，反而讓這位年輕泳者失去了所有自信。
a destructive force: The typhoon was a destructive force that knocked down trees, flooded streets, and left thousands of homes without power.
這個颱風是一股毀滅性的力量，吹倒樹木、淹沒街道，並使數千戶家庭停電。
destructive behavior: Breaking things whenever he gets angry is destructive behavior that his parents are trying hard to help him change.
他每次生氣就摔東西，這是破壞性行為，他的父母正努力幫助他改掉。
the digital age: In the digital age, most teenagers get their news from social media rather than from newspapers or TV.
在數位時代，大多數青少年是從社群媒體而非報紙或電視獲得新聞。
digital natives: Young people who grew up with smartphones are digital natives, so they learn new apps much faster than their grandparents.
伴隨智慧型手機長大的年輕人是數位原住民，所以他們學新應用程式比祖父母快得多。
digital literacy: Schools now teach digital literacy so that students can judge whether the information they find online is true.
學校現在教授數位素養，讓學生能判斷他們在網路上找到的資訊是否屬實。
go digital: Many small shops decided to go digital during the pandemic, selling their products online instead of waiting for customers.
疫情期間許多小店決定數位化，在網路上販售商品，而不是等顧客上門。
a diligent student: As a diligent student, Amy reviews her notes every night and has never handed in her homework late.
身為一個勤奮的學生，艾咪每晚都複習筆記，而且從未遲交作業。
diligent research: After two years of diligent research in the library and the lab, the scientist finally found the answer.
在圖書館和實驗室經過兩年勤勉細心的研究後，這位科學家終於找到了答案。
a dim memory: I have only a dim memory of my first day at kindergarten because it happened so long ago.
我對幼稚園第一天只有模糊的記憶，因為那是很久以前的事了。
take a dim view of: My parents take a dim view of students who play mobile games all night, and they often warn my brother about it.
我爸媽對整晚玩手機遊戲的學生不以為然，而且常常為此告誡我弟弟。
a dim prospect: With the factory closing, workers in the small town face a dim prospect of finding new jobs nearby.
隨著工廠關閉，這個小鎮的工人在附近找到新工作的前景黯淡。
a dim light: Reading under a dim light for hours can hurt your eyes, so please turn on a brighter lamp.
在昏暗的光線下閱讀好幾個小時會傷眼睛，所以請打開一盞比較亮的燈。
dim and distant past: Grandpa loves telling stories about his school days, which seem to belong to the dim and distant past.
爺爺喜歡講他求學時期的故事，那些事彷彿屬於遙遠模糊的過去。
diplomatic relations: The two countries cut off diplomatic relations after the war and closed their embassies in each other's capitals.
兩國在戰後斷絕外交關係，並關閉了在彼此首都的大使館。
a diplomatic answer: When reporters asked whether he liked the new coach, the player gave a diplomatic answer, cleverly avoiding saying yes or no.
記者問他是否喜歡新教練時，這位球員給了一個圓滑婉轉的回答，巧妙地避免說是或不是。
diplomatic immunity: Because the man worked at a foreign embassy, he had diplomatic immunity and could not be arrested by local police.
因為這名男子在外國大使館工作，他享有外交豁免權，當地警方無法逮捕他。
be very diplomatic: Our class leader is very diplomatic; she always settles arguments without making anyone feel embarrassed.
我們的班長非常有手腕；她總能化解爭吵，又不讓任何人感到難堪。
dishonest means: He got rich through dishonest means, such as cheating customers and lying about the quality of his products.
他透過不正當的手段致富，例如欺騙顧客和謊報產品品質。
a dishonest answer: When the teacher asked who broke the window, Tom gave a dishonest answer and blamed his classmate instead.
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，湯姆給了一個不誠實的回答，反而怪罪他的同學。
a distinct possibility: With dark clouds gathering, rain this afternoon is a distinct possibility, so you had better bring an umbrella.
烏雲正在聚集，今天下午下雨有明顯的可能性，所以你最好帶把傘。
distinct from: Taiwanese bubble tea is quite distinct from ordinary milk tea because of its chewy tapioca balls.
台灣珍珠奶茶因為有Q彈的粉圓，與一般奶茶截然不同。
a distinct advantage: Being able to speak three languages gave her a distinct advantage when she applied for the job at the hotel.
會說三種語言讓她在應徵飯店工作時有明顯的優勢。
as distinct from: This course focuses on spoken English, as distinct from the grammar and reading taught in regular classes.
這門課著重英語口說，而非一般課堂所教的文法和閱讀。
a distinctive feature: The tall red gate is a distinctive feature of the temple, so visitors can recognize it from far away.
高大的紅色山門是這座廟宇獨特的特徵，所以遊客從遠處就能認出它。
a distinctive voice: The singer has a distinctive voice, so fans can recognize her songs within a few seconds on the radio.
這位歌手有很有辨識度的聲音，所以歌迷在收音機上幾秒內就能認出她的歌。
a distinctive style: The artist has a distinctive style of bright colors and thick lines, so his paintings are easy to recognize.
這位畫家有鮮豔色彩和粗線條的獨特風格，所以他的畫作很容易辨認。
a distinguished career: After a distinguished career of forty years, the famous surgeon retired and received an award for his work.
在四十年卓越的事業之後，這位知名外科醫師退休並因其貢獻獲頒獎項。
a distinguished guest: The principal welcomed the mayor as a distinguished guest and invited him to give a speech at the graduation ceremony.
校長以貴賓之禮歡迎市長，並邀請他在畢業典禮上致詞。
a distinguished scholar: Professor Lin is a distinguished scholar whose books on Taiwanese history are read by students around the world.
林教授是一位傑出的學者，他關於台灣歷史的著作被世界各地的學生閱讀。
distinguished-looking: A tall, distinguished-looking man in a gray suit walked into the hall, and everyone assumed he was the new manager.
一位身穿灰色西裝、高大且氣質出眾的男士走進大廳，大家都以為他是新任經理。
